name: OmarCraft
author: Entangled-Forge
description: Productivity tools from the Omarchy bar: ArtCraft's apps (PhotoCraft, WordCraft, SolidCraft and more), Typesetter, Memospot and Planify, in three categories. See what is installed, launch, install one tool or a category, update, remove. Prebuilt packages only (Omarchy's or the Arch repos, or AUR -bin), through Omarchy's own package commands. Unofficial.

barWidget.description: Craft apps and more: installed, available, updates. Left = panel, right = check the AUR, middle = switch layout.
